requirements.description: Define one repository-owned synthetic reference workflow, expected results and failure cases. No customer interview, paid account, external pilot count or market-validation claim is required.

Record exact supported runtime, engine, provider/image, grammar, rule and fixture versions/digests, licenses and official release sources. Use real dependency lockfiles and preserve a source-build route.

npm run setup prepares the actual selected local engine and npm start supervises the web workspace and loopback engine with clean shutdown. Minimal health does not imply completed business features; no second undocumented terminal is required.

Implement exact typed domain inputs, output/error codes, size/time/cancellation limits and positive/negative compatibility fixtures. Generic nested JSON is not a domain contract. No database schema change is allowed.

Use ADR-0003 storage ports, a bounded single writer, atomic visible state, stable operation IDs and tested interrupted/disk-full/replay recovery. No database schema, migration, .env or Dockerfile changes.

Build and test the actual selected engine, typed contracts and storage using pinned local open-source providers where relevant. Add exact engine test commands and collect the listed test directories. Shell-only tests cannot verify an engine.
Event IDs and monotonic sequence survive restart and validate payload limits.
Replay and zero/overlong TTL fail; tokens are stored hashed.
Expired, untrusted and revoked certificates cannot ingest events.
Unsigned or stale desired state fails without replacing active config.
Crash during config apply converges with recorded applied revision.
No command execution or sensitive response echo occurs and request size is bounded.
Decoy cannot call Internet or operational private subnets; PID and memory limits hold.
Disconnect and restart retain accepted events up to configured bound.
Full spool follows documented drop policy with gap marker and cannot fill host disk.
Lost ACK may replay but cannot create duplicate incident observations.
Crash at rotation preserves valid records and marks incomplete final record explicitly.
Index loss rebuilds from committed segments without claiming missing events as ingested.
Alert references source events and distinguishes sensor-health problems from attacks.
Triage cannot silently alter observed source event content.
Offline sensor, stale applied config and dropped-event count are visible.
Events are escaped and every alert can be traced to source segment.
Deletion updates indexes and retains explicit retention gap metadata.
Old cert fails after documented overlap; offline sensor has recovery path.
Wrong signer, revoked version and rollback outside explicit recovery policy are rejected.
Bounded spool, duplicate batches, collector restart and egress tests pass together.
Execute this project's negative UAT, XSS/import and object/provider authorization tests for every enabled surface. Fix critical/high findings or block the affected supported profile.

Record hardware, OS, source and fixture identities, latency/CPU/RSS/disk, cancellation and saturation for the target and an over-limit workload. Publish only observed limits and reduce unsupported targets.
Separate web health from engine, authoritative storage and required provider readiness. Failures are visible; logs are bounded and exclude synthetic secret/credential sentinels.

On a clean supported Linux host, git clone -> npm run setup -> npm start completes this project's full reference workflow, negative cases, restart and restore with verified C01-C30 evidence. This is the first locally usable supported product.

Package the actual engine, web UI and offline rules/resources, source archive/build recipes, SBOM, upstream notices, checksums and provenance. A web-only artifact cannot satisfy this complete-product task.
Local operation needs no owned public domain. Prove loopback/origin/cache boundaries and document optional TLS/private ingress without exposing engine work by default.

Complete the actual reference workflow with keyboard/table equivalents at 360px and 1440px, invalid/empty/interrupted/provider-outage cases and N-1 data/export fixtures. Advertise only observed supported platforms.

A fresh reader completes the core task from public instructions. Document source builds, licenses, data/limits/privacy/recovery/support and a confirmed vulnerability reporting route without mandatory cloud or paid entitlements.

Verify integrity and authenticity against independently trusted release identity/key. Install, upgrade and roll back on supported hosts without discarding newer accepted data; maintain the documented source-build alternative.

A separate clean environment or independent contributor follows only the public guide and completes the actual core workflow. Record observed effort and failures; customer demand and five pilots are not prerequisites for OSS usability.
Fix actual C30/C33/C35/C36 failures with targeted regressions and repeat affected checks. Keep unresolved blockers explicit; never invent feedback or weaken an invariant to claim completion.
Document local data locations, export/deletion/retention/backup/recovery, supported profiles and maintenance/dependency policy. No required hosted subscription, paid core feature or unearned SLA.

Verify actual evidence for C01-C38, full clone-to-value, complete source/engine packaging, dependency/fixture licenses and supported-profile security/recovery. Planning templates, missing proofs and wrong-source evidence fail the release gate.

Use a maintainer-authorized publication workflow to publish the verified source/tag and full artifacts. Install the actual published version on a clean host and complete the same core task; retain real source/version, results and rollback evidence.

status_semantics: Status mirrors the owning card in plans/progress.json; verified refers to source-bound historical evidence, not product readiness.
